summary:
The Communities of Recovery Reauthorization Act of 2025 (H.R. 2695) is a single-subject legislative proposal that amends Section 547(f) of the Public Health Service Act (codified at 42 U.S.C. § 290ee-2(f)) to reauthorize and increase the funding authorization for grants targeted at building communities of recovery. 

Specifically, Section 2 of the bill strikes the expired authorization of appropriations of $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 through 2023. In its place, the bill inserts a new authorization of appropriations of $17,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030. This amendment represents a threefold increase in the annual authorized funding level for the program and establishes a new five-year authorization period. The bill contains no appropriations, effective dates, conditions precedent, or exceptions.
